comparison.objective: Sand a plywood edge with five complete flat passes; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated tangential contact, tool-flatness maintenance, and moderate force control versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, discrete hammer impulses, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Five whole-edge passes with the block flat while avoiding workpiece slip or edge rounding versus four valid fractures and complete tang containment without insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both regulate contact forces, but sustained abrasive stroking tests a meaningfully different mechanism and outcome from impulse-driven notch fracture.
